## Purpose

The portal is built from <repo>/.wiki/store.json by portal/build-portal.sh in two modes that share one assembly core (assemble.py): wiki_build_portal emits a single self-contained index.html (small-wiki default; it also deletes any pages/ and data/ left by an earlier paged build so the distribution always matches the requested mode), while wiki_build_portal_paged emits a small shell plus pages/<view>.html, pages/capability-<fid>.html and data/*.json, with the shell payload holding only {meta, coverage}. Both modes run the five view modules (arch, catalog, state, change, data) into JSON, pre-render mermaid state diagrams to inline SVG when mmdc exists (best effort: missing binary skips the step, per-entity render failure or 120s timeout falls back to the template's transitions table), then selfcheck every assembled page before anything is installed: a leftover __WIKI_PAYLOAD__ placeholder, any external reference (<link, src="http, href="http), remote CSS (@import, url(http)), or a payload that does not re-extract and json.loads from the <script id="wiki-payload"> tag is a hard 'generator bug' failure that aborts with no partial output; install itself is atomic (tmp file + rename), and the paged mode swaps pages/ and data/ in before installing the shell last. Serving runs through wiki_serve in portal/serve.sh, reached from the wiki dispatcher via lib/serve.sh glue (which only sources portal/serve.sh and wraps nothing): unless --static it rebuilds first so the served page matches the current store (build failure aborts with 'missing store? run: wiki sync'), pre-checks the port (--port N > $WIKI_PORT, default 4885; 0 = ephemeral; busy port or missing python3 exits 66), spawns portal/server.py bound to 127.0.0.1 only, and polls up to ~15s for the server.json recovery file plus an HTTP 200 before printing the URL and opening a browser (VS Code Simple Browser by default, WSL2 wslview->explorer.exe->cmd.exe chain fallback, opened only when stdout is a TTY). server.py is Python stdlib only: it serves the built page, paged assets and readme/wiki/<fid>/wiki.md, and persists annotation patches atomically (tmp + rename under a lock) to .wiki/annotations.json; every POST requires a localhost Origin header and JSON Content-Type, ids are restricted to feature:|entity:|module: targets with a 20000-char note cap and 64KB body cap, and an empty note deletes. Two named failure paths: a selfcheck violation or view/assembly failure in the builder exits 1 with no partial output, and a malformed existing annotations.json (unparseable, or missing its 'annotations' object) makes the server refuse to start with exit 2, printing 'fix or remove it manually, refusing to start and overwrite', rather than clobbering reader annotations; --static serves read-only (annotation POSTs answer 403), and --stop TERM-then-KILLs only the pidfile pid whose /proc cmdline still contains server.py, so a recycled pid is never killed.

- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/lib/serve.sh:1`: lib/serve.sh is pure dispatcher glue: `wiki serve [repo] [flags]` resolves its own directory and sources ../portal/serve.sh, which defines wiki_serve (repo optional, default $PWD), wiki_serve_is_serving and wiki_serve_open_browser; nothing is wrapped.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/build-portal.sh:1`: Two build modes share one assembly core (assemble.py): wiki_build_portal <store> <repo> [out] writes one self-contained page (default .wiki/portal/index.html) and clears pages/ and data/ left by an earlier paged build; wiki_build_portal_paged writes index.html + pages/<view>.html + pages/capability-<fid>.html + data/*.json with the shell payload holding only {meta, coverage}. Payload shape consumed by template.html: {arch, catalog, state, change, data, coverage, meta:{repo, generated_at, stale, degraded, fingerprint}} where coverage is the `wiki coverage --json` report, stale means store fingerprint differs from the wiki-fp marker in readme/feature-status.md, and degraded is non-empty when the store is not snapshot-backed. Any violation is a hard fail with the label on stderr. (source changed; review needed)
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/build-portal.sh:181`: wiki_build_portal: mktemp work dir -> run views -> mermaid -> assemble.py single -> selfcheck (comment: 'hard fail: generator bug') -> rm -rf portal/pages and portal/data (single mode owns the whole distribution) -> atomic install via tmp+mv (line 173) -> prints the out path. wiki_build_portal_paged (line 222) selfchecks EVERY *.html under the work root (find | sort), then installs pages/ and data/ first and the shell index.html atomically last. (source changed; review needed)
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/server.py:1`: server.py is a stdlib-only local annotation server: serves the self-contained portal from <wiki-dir>/portal/, persists every annotation patch atomically (tmp + rename) to <wiki-dir>/annotations.json, one process per wiki dir, binds 127.0.0.1 only; POSTs require a matching localhost Origin and JSON Content-Type; a malformed existing annotations.json fails startup without replacing it. Routes: GET / (portal index), GET/POST /api/annotations, GET /wiki/<fid> (readme/wiki/<fid>/wiki.md), GET /pages/<name>.html and /data/<name>.json (paged builds). Exit codes: 0 served until interrupt, 2 bad inputs/state, 3 port busy.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/server.py:47`: PortalState startup refusal: an existing annotations.json that fails json.loads (OSError/JSONDecodeError) or lacks an 'annotations' object prints 'refusing to start and overwrite' and raises SystemExit(2) instead of clobbering reader data. patch() validates the id against ^(feature|entity|module): (max 200 chars), rejects unknown body fields, caps notes at MAX_NOTE=20000 with MAX_BODY=65536, treats an empty note as delete, and persists under a threading.Lock via tmp file + os.replace in the same directory.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/server.py:130`: Every response carries Cache-Control: no-store, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and a CSP of default-src 'none' with img-src 'self' data:, style/script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline', connect-src 'self'. do_GET (line 159) routes / and /index.html to the built page (404 'portal not built; run: wiki build' when absent); _serve_wiki_page (line 212) regex-validates the fid and resolves readme/wiki/<fid>/wiki.md, requiring the parent (or grandparent) to be the wiki root; _serve_portal_asset (line 228) only serves a regex-validated single filename whose resolved parent equals the base dir, so path traversal cannot leave pages/ or data/.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/server.py:182`: do_POST ladder: read_only mode answers 403 'static mode: annotations are read-only'; a non-local Origin answers 403; a non-JSON Content-Type answers 415; a body over MAX_BODY answers 413; invalid JSON or a non-object body answers 400; a patch ValueError (bad id, unknown field, oversized note) answers 400; success returns {ok, id, record, clientTs}.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/server.py:246`: main() requires <wiki-dir>/portal/index.html to exist (else exit 2, 'run: wiki build'), constructs PortalState, binds ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 with --port 0 meaning ephemeral (bind failure exits 3), writes the recovery file portal/server.json {url, port, pid, started, wiki_dir, read_only}, prints the info JSON on stdout, then serves until KeyboardInterrupt (exit 0). --read-only is the flag behind static serving.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/serve.sh:5`: wiki_serve [repo] [--port N] [--stop] [--static] owns the server lifecycle: build (unless --static), start, wait for HTTP 200, open the browser. Exit 1 on build or startup failure, 66 on busy port or missing python3; --stop TERM-polls 2s then KILLs and always clears the pidfile, and stopping an already-stopped portal exits 0. Files: pidfile .wiki/cache/serve.pid, log serve.log next to it, recovery file .wiki/portal/server.json. Browser opening is TTY-gated (tests/CI get none) with WIKI_SERVE_OPEN=0/1 override.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/serve.sh:90`: Start path: an already-serving check (pidfile pid live and /proc cmdline contains server.py) short-circuits by reading the port from server.json and printing the existing URL; --static requires an already-built index.html (else exit 1 'run: wiki build'), otherwise wiki_build_portal runs against <repo>/.wiki/store.json and failure aborts with 'missing store? run: wiki sync'; port resolution is --port N > $WIKI_PORT (defaulted to 4885 by wiki-env.sh), validated numeric, with a pre-bind socket check returning 66 on a busy port.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/serve.sh:127`: The server is spawned as `python3 server.py --wiki-dir <repo>/.wiki --port <port>` (plus --read-only under --static), appended to serve.log, backgrounded with its pid written to the pidfile; readiness is a 75x0.2s loop that fails fast if the pid died (printing the last 3 log lines), else waits for server.json and an urllib HTTP 200 probe, then prints the URL and opens the browser; a timeout TERMs the server with 'did not become healthy'. wiki_serve_is_serving (line 181) requires the /proc/<pid>/cmdline to still contain server.py, so a recycled pid is never killed by --stop.
- `.claude/skills/cfn-wiki/portal/serve.sh:194`: Browser mode resolution: WIKI_BROWSER env > .wiki/config.json 'browser' key > default 'vscode' (VS Code Simple Browser via `code --open-url vscode://simpleBrowser.show?url=...`); mode 'system' (or a `code` failure/absence) falls back to the WSL2 chain wslview -> explorer.exe -> cmd.exe, best-effort because explorer.exe often returns nonzero on success.
